revisions.summary: Safe returnless ERFS recovery: restored genuine Ford 0-70 psi FRPS transfer (ECM 7596), restored manifold vacuum multiplier 0.484 (ECM 6950), raised idle to 950 RPM (ECM 44218/17), smoothed 64°F cranking cliff (ECM 44519), cleaned 2,500 RPM open-loop lean pockets (ECM 44511), applied v037 VCT reversion lockout (ECM 44412), and preserved conservative 11.0° spark timing on Load 2.00 (ECM 44583) for stock 10.2:1 compression safety.

ECM 44511 (Fuel Base vs. RPM vs. TPS: 2500 RPM lean pockets 1.07/1.14 -> 1.00)
ECM 44412 (VCT Angle vs. RPM vs. Load: applied v037 reversion lockout above 3.5k in boost and across 4.5k-7.2k)
